hits.title: PhotoShelter Announces New CEO: Andrew Fingerman
hits.snippet: New York, NY, May 2, 2012 - PhotoShelter (http://www.photoshelter.com), PhotoShelter, the leader in photography portfolio websites, sales, marketing and archiving tools announced today that Andrew Fingerman will be named the company’s new ... New York, NY, May 2, 2012 - PhotoShelter (http://www.photoshelter.com), PhotoShelter, the leader in photography portfolio websites, sales, marketing and archiving tools announced today that Andrew Fingerman will be named the company’s new Chief Executive Officer. Andrew replaces PhotoShelter Co-Founder Allen Murabayashi who has led the company as CEO since its inception in 2005.
